text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Deputy Premier Tareq Aziz meets his Jordanian counterpart in Amman and travels to Paris.
- Four destroyed missile engines were found during joint excavations by Iraqi and U.N. experts.
- Qatari Prime Minister greets President Saddam Hussein on the holy month of Ramadan.
- Israel declares a war of spying against Egypt.
- A vessel loaded with cooking oil arrives in Umm Qasr port in southern Iraq.
- Uday Saddam Hussein receives a group of young men from the United Arab Emirates who wished him a fast recovery from wounds received in assassination attempt.
